name: Resinite
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level druid 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 Levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Reflex negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You conjure a small sphere of sticky, viscous resin that automatically strikes the target creature. The substance immediately hardens on contact, effectively staggering the creature for the duration of the spell. A creature can negate this effect with a Strength check (DC 10 + your Wisdom modifier) or an Escape Artist check as a standard action (DC 10+ your caster level+ your Wisdom modifier).
